item.title: Almost 100 Adults Now Living Homeless In Clare
item.description: Almost 100 adults are now living in emergency accommodation in Clare. The Department of Housing’s latest report shows there was a significant increase in homelessness here ahead of the Christmas period. The Homeless report for November shows that 674 adults and 302 children were living in emergency accommodation in the MidWest.
